name: cdn-ech-outer-block-stateless
description: cdn-ech-outer-block held by a box that does not reassemble (first two data packets joined, name read as soon as it is whole, RST+ACK to the client). An ECH hello carries the outer name early, so it is caught here too. Op cdn: the one-record ECH hello is reset, no plain fallback (the zone name is again a tripwire), and the split hello (h:split) carries, as in cdn-ech-outer-block.
analogue: The cloudflare-ech.com block as Iran's two-packet SNI box would apply it. Model limits as cdn-ech-outer-block and sni-rst-first-two.
